topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The lord of the manor has spoken, and the fields we tend may soon belong to others, each plot divided, fenced, and claimed. It’s said the new masters will come, their titles grand and their hearts cold to the sweat we spill on the earth. What will become of us, who know no life but this? The chapel bell rings clear as ever, but even the saints seem to stand silent, the sky above as gray as the stone from which our homes are made. The harvest is still in, but the winter looms, long and hard, with questions we cannot answer.
